component.name: WPS Office International
WPS Office 国际版
component.summary: Office suite for documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDF
处理文档、表格、演示和 PDF 的办公套件

description.p: This is a community package that repackages the official WPS Office for Linux build (International Edition, from wps.com) unmodified. It is not verified by, affiliated with, or supported by WPS Software Pte. Ltd.

WPS Office combines Writer, Spreadsheets, Presentation and PDF tools in one suite. It opens, edits and saves Microsoft Office files (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX) as well as its own formats, and supports international WPS accounts, cloud documents and an interface in 20 languages. For the mainland China edition, install cn.wps.linux.
The package adds a single WPS Office launcher. Documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs all open in the combined WPS Office window.

WPS Office runs on X11 (XWayland on a Wayland session). It can open and save files in Documents, Downloads and Desktop. A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Your whole home folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home com.wps.Office
USB drives and other removable media: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media --filesystem=/media com.wps.Office
Undo all of these: flatpak override --user --reset com.wps.Office
